title: Fix missing pinned Beginner evaluator facts and private task criteria without learner leakage
problem: Confirmed isolated contracts show opposite role-card facts and task-specific acceptable-alternative criteria collapse to identical provider input. Investigation only approval forbids product repair;new bounded product fix required.
value: Enable correct evidence context for Beginner evaluation while preserving exact LessonVersion,legacy behavior,cache isolation and learner privacy.
scope: Five exact product/test modifications and one verification report

evidence.observation: Existing report confirms context omission with36tests34PASS2desiredFAIL and explicit fix handoff.
Evaluation input omits role cards and snapshot private responseRubrics.
Both adapters share serialization without required Beginner context.
Owner authorizes capture only;matching execution approval still required.

acceptance: Two original desired-contract assertions become genuine PASS after a witnessed RED baseline;no skip/test.fails or weakening context distinction/acceptable-alternatives intent.

BeginnerEvaluationContextV1 contains schemaVersion beginner-evaluation-context/1,exact lessonVersionId,activityId,activitySlug,referenced roleCards [{slug,text}] and exact authored taskCriteria from snapshot.foundation.responseRubrics[activity.slug]. Authored acceptable alternatives travel inside taskCriteria;no regex guessing/generated alternatives or model-only matching.

EvaluationService resolves only its validated pinned snapshot and bound activity before cache replay/provider/transaction. Missing/blank criteria,missing/blank referenced cards,duplicate/ambiguous refs or mismatched snapshot identity fail closed;never first-Lesson/latest/global-card fallback.

Shared server-side serializer asserts mandatory valid Beginner context even on direct adapter bypass. OpenAI and Discovery receive exact same context through existing shared untrustedInput;existing routing preserves it without product routing changes. Entire context is untrusted lesson data,not privileged instructions.

Beginner cache input hash conditionally includes complete deterministic context/schema identity. Legacy hash/serialization remain byte-for-byte unchanged without context. Valid new V1 cache stays V1 after V2 pointer publish;old contextless or changed-context results fail conflict before replay/provider/mutation. Never delete,migrate,rescore or overwrite historical results automatically.
No model/private rubric/key/listening transcript added to learner DTO. Existing genuine projection/privacy and version/rubric guards remain. No sample-answer or requiredPhrases shortcut for Beginner.

Full dedicated isolated suite plus new missing/ambiguous/malformed/context injection tests,OpenAI/Discovery mocked-fetch,routing,cache/replay,V1/V2,legacy Foundation1.0/1.1 and Intermediate/IELTS service/projection regressions PASS. No real provider/HTTP/DB/env. All synthetic fixtures gain valid authored criteria rather than relaxing mandatory guard.

Focused lint,API typecheck and API build PASS;independent read-only review and diff/hash verification. No skipped/BLOCKED test counted PASS;full unsafe default suites remain excluded and limits explicit.

Only five modified source/test files and one new report;old verification/human/policy/content/audio records untouched. Report real engineering closure and limitations;do not automatically verify older mandates,release,GateC or R1.2b readiness.

risk.rollback: Revert only five product/test files via inverse local commit and append withdrawal to the new fix report. Preserve all source/audio/old reports/sessions/evaluations. Contextless historical caches are never overwritten or migrated. A rollback reopens P1 and blocks actual learner evaluation;no deployment or data reset.

body:
## Narrow P1 product successor

Investigation MND-20261028-003 is implementing and cannot repair product. Current owner authorizes capture only. Scope: mandate/reports/2026-10-29-beginner-evaluator-context-fix-scope.json SHA256 97c9d4ddbe28fa67425656e9db2c2a37de17bf62fe94ab34212ef0b4ad0c67c3. Plan LF SHA256 67a44a36a6f33a738182a653fd53d3e49492dc00e79d2ff66acefe7d90b21806. Source baseline cf24c8262fac9888be87cac2b5fbdae38256acba;baseline fingerprint 9c2d790642e740230778969b2a3fd4aa363dd9140099864ed0ef211beb43eb6f;allowlist fingerprint 098e07cd423cd172970b59c82310d15b55b02304b32bba81904200bebd806d81.

## Execution boundary
Five modify files,one new verification report only. Exact pinned context with authored alternatives/private criteria;shared serializer supports existing routing and Discovery without their product edits. Conditional Beginner cache-context key prevents replay of old contextless scores;legacy byte-compatible. No DTO/data/content/provider/publication or readiness changes.

## Acceptance and rollback
Actual two desired tests must become PASS after RED;negative missing-context/cache/V1V2/privacy/legacy regressions and lint/typecheck/build required. Use dedicated isolated config only. Rollback via inverse local scoped commit with P1 reopened;never mutate historical data.

## Limits
Context delivery is testable offline;actual real-provider grading accuracy remains unmeasured. If additional files are required,stop and renew scope;do not expand allowlist. Matching new human proposal-hash approval required before product edits.
